from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
root=Path.cwd();p=root/"udt_common_geometry_whiteboard_2026-09-28"
launch=json.loads((p/"LAUNCH.json").read_text())
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
protected=("udt_kernel_plane_global_curvature_holonomy_atlas_2026-08-02/","udt_native_onshell_timelive_reset_owner_audit_2026-08-10/","udt_pair_regime_flow_reciprocal_orchestra_amplification_2026-08-12/","udt_sne_xmax_G88_am_radial_compatibility_atlas_2026-08-12/")

fixed=["AGENTS.md","CLAUDE.md","CANON.md","founding.md","CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.md","CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv","verify_current_scientific_premises.py"]
assert all(sha((root/x).read_bytes())==launch["source_sha256"][x] for x in fixed)
manifest=json.loads((p/"CONSTRUCTION_MANIFEST.json").read_text())
bad=[name for name,item in manifest["files"].items() if sha((p/name).read_bytes())!=item["sha256"] or (p/name).stat().st_size!=item["bytes"]]
assert not bad,bad
review_count=0
for line in (p/"review/REVIEW_MANIFEST.sha256").read_text().splitlines():
 expected,name=line.split("  ",1)
 assert not name.startswith(protected)
 assert sha((root/name).read_bytes())==expected,name
 review_count+=1
pins={}
for name in ["causal/SOURCE_PINS.json","kernel/SOURCE_PINS.json","parent/SOURCE_PINS.json"]:
 for path,expected in json.loads((p/name).read_text())["source_sha256"].items():
  pins.setdefault(path,set()).add(expected)
for row in json.loads((p/"horizons/SOURCE_PINS.json").read_text())["repo_sources"]:
 pins.setdefault(row["path"],set()).add(row["sha256"])
snapshot=json.loads((p/"STATUS_AT_CONSTRUCTION.json").read_text())
reconstructed=json.loads((p/"checks/status_snapshot_reconstruction.json").read_text())
assert reconstructed["returncode"]==0 and all(reconstructed["reconstructed_matches"].values())
historical=[]; checked=0
for name,expecteds in pins.items():
 assert not name.startswith(protected),name
 current=sha((root/name).read_bytes())
 for expected in expecteds:
  checked+=1
  if current==expected:continue
  if name in snapshot["files_sha256"] and snapshot["files_sha256"][name]==expected:
   assert sha((Path(reconstructed["scratch_directory"])/name).read_bytes())==expected
   historical.append({"source":name,"record":"STATUS_AT_CONSTRUCTION.patch"});continue
  if name==str((p/"WORK_ORDER.md").relative_to(root)) and sha((p/"AUTHORIZED_WORK_ORDER.md").read_bytes())==expected:
   historical.append({"source":name,"record":"AUTHORIZED_WORK_ORDER.md"});continue
  if name in maintained and sha(subprocess.check_output(["git","show",launch["head"]+":"+name]))==expected:
   historical.append({"source":name,"record":"launch git commit"});continue
  raise AssertionError("Unpreserved source pin: "+name)
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()==launch["head"]
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","branch","--show-current"],text=True).strip()=="grok"
tracked=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only"],text=True).splitlines())
assert tracked<=maintained|{str((p/"WORK_ORDER.md").relative_to(root))},tracked
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--cached","--name-only"],text=True).strip()
untracked=[x for x in subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard","-z"]).decode().split("\0") if x]
old=sorted(x for x in untracked if not x.startswith(p.name+"/"))
assert old==sorted(launch["preexisting_untracked_paths"])
print(json.dumps({"utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"python":sys.version.split()[0],"status":"PASS_CORRESPONDENCE_AND_PRESERVATION","fixed_authority_and_scientific_files":len(fixed),"construction_files_unchanged":len(manifest["files"]),"original_review_files_unchanged":review_count,"source_versions_checked":checked,"historical_status_versions":historical,"preexisting_untracked_paths_preserved":len(old),"protected_payloads":"NOT_READ_OR_HASHED","index_before_banking":"EMPTY","tracked_changes":"only six maintained files and package work order","scope":"Correspondence and preservation, not proof, independence or physical truth"},indent=2))
